title: A value set on a flow mapping key that has a colon and nothing after it
notes: `b:` before a comma is a key with an empty value (yaml-test-suite 4ABK). Setting the value puts it after the colon, with one space by the kit convention. `b:2` would not do: in a flow mapping that text is one plain scalar.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the native backend refused the edit as one that would not read back; the pure backend wrote `b:2`.
